description: Export a doc as a self-contained envelope: doc row (Tiptap body, SEO, full_path) + site settings + domains. Docs are prose-first, so there are no component bodies to inline (unlike content_export_page). format='json' (default) returns the JSON envelope; format='md' returns human-readable Markdown rendered from the body.

format.description: json (default) — JSON envelope; md — Markdown rendered from the Tiptap body.

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: content_export_doc
